tasks.label: 0. REDIS (Redis Stack)
args: docker inspect redis-stack >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker start redis-stack || echo "Container redis-stack nao existe. Cria-o com: docker run -d --name redis-stack -p 6379:6379 redis/redis-stack-server:latest"

tasks.label: 2. FRONTEND (Vue/Vite)
args:
set -e
cd /home/gilal/tuts-workspace/tuts-core
echo "A aguardar pelo Laravel/Sail..."
until container=$(./vendor/bin/sail ps -q laravel.test 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$container" ] && docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container" 2>/dev/null | grep -q true; do
  sleep 2
done

echo "A limpar Vite/npm/node antigo dentro do container..."
docker exec "$container" sh -lc 'pkill -9 -f [v]ite 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -9 -f [n]pm 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -9 -f [n]ode 2>/dev/null || true'

rm -f public/hot

echo "A iniciar Vue/Vite..."
./vendor/bin/sail npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0

tasks.label: 3. RAG (Python/FastAPI)
args:
set -e
cd /home/gilal/tuts-workspace/tuts-rag-service
if [ ! -x ./venv/bin/python3 ]; then
  echo "RAG venv Linux nao encontrado em ./venv/bin/python3"
  exit 1
fi
./venv/bin/python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8001 --env-file .env --reload --reload-dir . --reload-exclude .venv --reload-exclude venv --reload-exclude faiss_db --reload-exclude __pycache__ --reload-exclude pdfs
